sections.title: Introduction
sections.text:
The goal of this Tier List is to inform players regarding
how strong Heroes are in the current metagame on Haunted Mines.
Haunted Mines is a 2-lane Map with no Boss Camps, 2 Siege Camps, and 2 Sapper Camps.
You cannot double-soak
and being global is rarely useful.
You may want to pick Heroes who can easily clear the Objective,
otherwise just make sure to kill enemy Heroes before they can secure it.
Make sure to have some Heroes who can take care of Mercenary Camps.
See our Haunted Mines Map Guide for further information »

sections.title: Guidelines
sections.text:
A well-rounded team composition has: 1 Tank,
1 Offlaner, 1 Ranged Assassin,
1 Flex, and 1 Healer. The flex slot can be filled with:
1 Bruiser, 1 Melee Assassin,
1 Ranged Assassin, or 1 Healer.
If a given Hero can be played in different Roles (for example Tank
and Offlaner), we mention them multiple times
because each of their Roles may belong to a different tier.
Heroes that are generally worth banning at the beginning of the draft have been marked with a red border
and a BAN label, however, in some circumstances it may be better to ban other Heroes instead,
either to target-ban a player and/or to remove a counter to Heroes your team will pick.
Heroes that do better on this Map compared to their overall ranking
have an upward-pointing arrow and name in green
whereas Heroes that do worse on this Map compared to their overall ranking
have a downward-pointing arrow and name in red.
You can see their overall ranking in our
General Tier List.

Details (click to expand)
Blaze is mainly being drafted as Offlaner
because his self-sustain allows him to stay in lane
for long periods of time and his high waveclear allows him
to have priority on the enemy Offlaner.
Brightwing is a well-rounded Healer
with crowd control, global presence,
a powerful Cleanse effect, and a solid healing output.
She is particularly good at dealing with high-mobility Heroes
(for example Genji).
Sylvanas is a versatile Ranged Assassin
capable of specializing into sustain damage or burst damage.
She also has access to Haunting Arrows, which is extremely useful for disabling
enemy Structures while pushing or diving.
"
Xal'atath is a powerful Ranged Assassin
with the ability to dish out a lot of damage from the distance. Void Step
allows her to make aggressive plays or to escape from dangerous situations.
Thanks to her high survivability and good waveclear,
Yrel is a solid Offlaner regardless
of the Map, however, she can be particularly scary when fights happen near
impassable terrain because
she can charge Avenging Wrath behind them.

Arthas can be played as Offlaner
against melee Heroes who rely on Basic Attacks and cannot deal with
Frozen Tempest because they lack
mobility tools to disengage whenever they want.
Deathwing is not a great Offlaner
because he has limited macro capabilities and deals 100% more damage to enemy Heroes, therefore
he performs better when picked as Melee Assassin in the 4-man.
Imperius can get enough waveclear
from Talents to become a good Offlaner, however,
he performs better when picked as Melee Assassin in the 4-man.

Blaze is rarely being drafted as a Tank
because his engage can easily be countered with a well-timed
crowd control effects, including Knockbacks.
E.T.C. can be played as Offlaner
by picking Stage Dive and using it to join allied Heroes
after taking care of a side lane. This strategy is particularly good on big Maps,
where global Heroes are valuable.
Uther can also be drafted as secondary Healer
to enable a powerful Melee Assassin (for example
Kerrigan) or Ranged Assassin (notably
Valla) so that they can deal more damage.
